container_command:
set -euo pipefail
ulimit -c 0
unset VITE_MODEL_CATALOG_URL GINFER_MODEL_CATALOG_URL IS_DEV NODE_OPTIONS NODE_ENV FORCE_ONBOARDING FRESH_INSTALL FORCE_HARDWARE_TIER TAURI_CONFIG TAURI_DEV_HOST TAURI_ENV_DEBUG IS_IOS IS_ANDROID IS_CLEAN CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS CARGO_BUILD_TARGET RUSTFLAGS GINFER_PROFILE_CATALOGS CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
run_stage() {
 stage="$1"; shift
 date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/${stage}.start"
 if "$@" > "/work/${stage}.log" 2>&1; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
 printf '%s\n' "$code" > "/work/${stage}.exit"
 date -u +%FT%TZ > "/work/${stage}.end"
 return "$code"
}
test -s core/dist/index.js
run_stage step-guidance-order cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --lib first_run::tests::shared_progress_resumes_in_order -- --exact --test-threads=1
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/work/step-guidance-order.log").read_text(); assert "test first_run::tests::shared_progress_resumes_in_order ... ok" in s and "1 passed" in s'
run_stage step-guidance-artifact cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --lib first_run::tests::verified_download_choices_precede_selected_profiling_and_survive_restart -- --exact --test-threads=1
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/work/step-guidance-artifact.log").read_text(); assert "test first_run::tests::verified_download_choices_precede_selected_profiling_and_survive_restart ... ok" in s and "1 passed" in s'
run_stage step-guidance-check cargo check --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --bin ginfer-host
run_stage step-guidance-clippy cargo clippy --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --all-targets
run_stage step-guidance-verify make verify
run_stage step-guidance-release cargo build --locked --offline --release --manifest-path src-tauri/ginfer-host/Cargo.toml --bin ginfer-host
mkdir -p /work/step-guidance-bin
install -m755 /work/native-target/release/ginfer-host /work/step-guidance-bin/ginfer-host
sha256sum /work/step-guidance-bin/ginfer-host > /work/step-guidance-host.sha256
ldd /work/step-guidance-bin/ginfer-host > /work/step-guidance-host-ldd.txt
! grep -q 'not found' /work/step-guidance-host-ldd.txt
